# Smith & Adams

> Independent real estate investment and residency advisory in Portugal. We help international investors build euro-denominated property portfolios and navigate the Golden Visa and D2 Visa routes.

Smith & Adams is a Lisbon-based, independent advisory that sources, structures and manages prime residential real estate in Portugal for international investors, and guides them through residency-by-investment (the Portugal Golden Visa) and the D2 entrepreneur/immigrant visa. The firm also operates its own developments (the Hygge House concept) and provides full, hands-off property management. Available in English and Portuguese.

## Key pages
- [Invest in Portugal - D2 Visa & Golden Visa](https://www.smithandadams.com/invest-in-portugal): The two proven routes to European residency, compared (purpose, timelines, investment).
- [About Smith & Adams](https://www.smithandadams.com/about): The independent advisory group and its approach.
- [Real Estate](https://www.smithandadams.com/real-estate): Curated investment properties across Portugal (Lisbon, Porto, Algarve, Cascais, Silver Coast), including Golden Visa-eligible options.
- [Property Management](https://www.smithandadams.com/property-management): End-to-end management for hands-off, euro-denominated rental income.
- [Our Developments](https://www.smithandadams.com/our-developments): The Hygge House projects in Lisbon and previous developments.
- [Blog](https://www.smithandadams.com/blog): Insights on Portuguese real estate, the Golden Visa, D2 Visa and the NHR tax regime.
